The '''1941–42 [[La Liga]]''' was the 11th season of Spanish football league. [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] won the first top-flight title in club history.

[[Real Sociedad]] returned to the first division after a three-season absence. [[Granada CF|Granada]], [[Deportivo La Coruña]] and [[CD Castellón|Castellón]] made their debut in La Liga.

For this season, [[Hércules CF|Hércules]] played with the denomination of ''Alicante CF''. The [[Alicante CF|namesake club]] acted as its reserve team with the name of ''Lucentum CF''.
